body.text: Research start UTC (date -u): 2026-11-03T05:32:21Z. Hard stop: 2026-11-03T13:32:21Z. Stage-1 reconstruction deadline: 2026-11-03T06:32:21Z. I will reconstruct and record before building the training simulation; criteria will be my own simulation claims. Task plan: initial toss/catch; spin then toss/catch twice; final spin and stable hold. The unmarked ball makes exact human spin unobservable, so spin criteria must explicitly distinguish instruction from measured video.

Video analysis: provisional detached flights frames 52-67, 163-178 and 200-216 (30 Hz). Robust SAM3 sphere fits independently estimate gravity magnitudes 9.33, 9.97 and 9.90 m/s^2 before enforcing gravity. Fitted rises from the first detached frame are 0.288, 0.321 and 0.300 m. Median object replay IoU is 0.944. Focal 1270.5 pixels remains an inferred MoGe prior because a sphere cannot uniquely calibrate focal length; this limitation will be preserved. All ball rotations remain explicitly unobservable. The updated VERIFICATION.md has been re-read.

reprojection.note: against your own masks: agreement with them is necessary, not sufficient (3D errors along the viewing ray are invisible here)

anatomical_contact.note: a grasp needs the thumb and an opposing finger on opposite sides of the object; single-finger pushes or palm support are legitimate but must be stated in the analysis. Low penetration does not imply contact.

penetration_hand_object.note: unsigned (lower bound) distances where the object mesh is not watertight

self_penetration.note: triangle intersections between different fingers (FCL); counts are not volumes

physics.note: free-flight intervals are given with --flight OBJ=a:b; rest intervals default to object intervals without contact

handedness_scale.note: left/right are the demonstrator's anatomical hands; a hand is never mirrored

camera_focal.note: MoGe intrinsics are a learned prior; the focal should be calibrated against known geometry (camera_calib.py pnp). A large disagreement needs its explanation in NOTES.md (which one is wrong, and why).

body.text: Reconstruction and criteria precede simulation. Plan: MuJoCo with exact URDF link inertias,20joints, specified1kHz PD and wrist impedance; PPO closed-loop residuals around the reconstructed wrist and a non-solving hand pose reference. The base will be evaluated by itself and must fail full criteria. The policy observes noisy encoders plus privileged simulated object pose/velocity, with no tactile observations. Nominal wrist translation speed2.5m/s permits a ballistic rise v^2/(2g)=.319m; measured0.29-.32m is attainable with a near-limit launch and finger contribution, although human wrist motion alone is slower. I will first learn support/spin and then whole-sequence flight/capture, reporting curriculum outcomes separately from full verification.

Re-read updated LEARNING.md section1 after operator update. Final actor observation will contain only noisy q/qd, wrist pose/velocity, previous finger/wrist targets, ball pose/linear/angular velocity, step index and fixed reference/task settings. No contacts, contact forces, applied or demanded torque, masses/friction, rewards, images or hidden simulator state enter the actor. Contacts and hardware quantities remain training-reward and verification measurements only. No privileged teacher is currently planned.

simulator.name: MuJoCo
simulator.contacts: Vendor STL convex hulls, rigid passive rubber pads; condim4, friction.8/.005/.001, solref .004 1, solimp .95 .99 .001. Floor pair solref .01 .7, energy-dissipating drop checks. Unknown physical contact properties are inferred.

scene.robot: public right Wuji Hand2.2 URDF and vendor STL meshes, all link masses/inertias retained, total.6878kg
scene.object: analytic sphere radius.0325m,mass.0577kg,diagonal shell inertia4.1e-5kgm2; world floor atz0,gravity -9.81

reference.retargeting: From fitted human wrist and palm/finger axes; robot+y=palm normal,-z=distal direction; initial wrist translatedto(0,0,.65). Short invalid gaps46,47,113 interpolated only for derived reference. Wrist base follows this reference; static cupped finger pose from geometric collision-aware IK. Ball training reference is reconstructed trajectory plus constant initial ball-center offset for robot palm geometry.
reference.use: Phase/object/wrist rewards; network residuals must add retention,spin,release,catch. Base alone fails.

wrist_and_fingers.wrist: Exact specified Cartesian impedance Kp2000,Kd60,Kr20,Dr.4,hand-only gravity compensation including moment,30N/2Nm saturation; executed-target rate caps2.5m/s and6rad/s. No wrist workspace constraint. Forces act only on root via mj_applyFT.
wrist_and_fingers.fingers: URDF-order20joints, specifiedkp/kd, current-limited torque effort, vendor armature. qtarget clipped to position limits and optional policy mapping target rates limited to.65*URDF speeds. PD qd_target=0. Actual speed/position/torque checked every1ms; violations terminate, no velocity state clipping. Encoder sigmaq.002rad,qd.05rad/s independently at500Hz.
wrist_and_fingers.actions: 26 network residuals:3wrist position*.08m,3rotationvector*.4rad around fixed reference,20finger position offsets*1rad around initial cup. Target projection then specified controllers.
wrist_and_fingers.observations: 108 deployable scalars from noisy encoders,wrist pose/velocity,ball pose/velocity,previous executed targets,step index and fixed task reference settings. No contacts/forces/torques/current/physical parameters/images/rewards/simulator internals.

initial_conditions.reason: Video starts in right palm-up support. Retargeted root pose fixed from frame0; sphere shifted~3cm relative human to allow robot pad geometry. Collision-aware geometric IK places pads~0.5mm from sphere with no ball penetration, then dynamics settles.

episode.termination: ball floor contact,ball-wrist distance>.6m,ball below wrist-.35m,nonfinite state,any finger hardware violation,or time limit. Curriculum hold3s(mode0),first toss3s(mode1),full10.5s(mode2) are separately labelled.
episode.reset: No welds/noncontact ball actuation; all states physical after initial reset.

baseline.reason: Static cup/reference wrist cannot retain ball through first throw and does not execute required spins.

floor_drop_test.interpretation: Dissipative and numerically stable at1ms; unknown actual restitution, floor contact fails task anyway.

limitations: Convex hull collision of vendor STL meshes; rubber pads represented as rigid compliant contacts.
Observed hand fit partly occluded; reference wrist3gaps interpolated.
Unknown friction/compliance inferred; no aerodynamic drag.
Reference replay is kinematic evidence, not task success.
